evals.prompt: Planifica el issue #42 de GitHub. Ya tiene la ficha de triage: exportar facturas a CSV con los mismos filtros del listado.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the issue with gh issue view, reuses the existing spec, explores the repo read-only to find the invoice controller and services, and writes the plan with MUST requirements and Given/When/Then scenarios, design, verified files, tasks linked to requirements and verification with real commands. It shows the plan, asks for confirmation and only then adds the 🛠️ Implementation Plan section to the issue body with gh issue edit --body-file, keeping the spec. It does not edit code and ends by suggesting idd-apply. The reply is in Spanish.

evals.prompt: Write the implementation plan for this Notion page: https://www.notion.so/acme/Recordatorios-por-email-9f8e7d6c5b4a
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the page with notion-fetch, explores the repo without changing it, asks only questions that change the scope (for example, the email provider if it is not in the repo), produces the full plan following the template and, after confirmation, writes it into the same page with notion-update-page. It does not create a local .md or start implementing.

evals.prompt: No uso ningún gestor de tareas. Planifica esto: añadir modo oscuro a la app respetando la preferencia del sistema.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks that no tracker is available, explores the repo to find the styling and theming system, produces the plan with verifiable requirements and scenarios, shows it and, on confirmation, saves it to docs/specs/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md with the 🛠️ Implementation Plan section. It stops without writing code. The reply is in Spanish.

evals.prompt: Plan issue #77: change the 'Submit' button text to 'Save changes' in the profile form.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes a small change (one module, few tasks, no data or API changes) and produces a short plan: Context, one requirement with a scenario, 1–3 tasks and Verification, without the design, out of scope or assumptions sections. It shows it, asks for confirmation and saves it in the issue. It does not edit code.

evals.prompt: Planifica ENG-300: migrar toda la autenticación a OAuth, añadir 2FA, rehacer la pantalla de login y el panel de sesiones activas.
evals.expected_output: The agent detects that the change holds several independent deliverables and would exceed about 12 tasks, and proposes splitting it into several items (one per deliverable) before writing a single plan. It does not create the items or write to Linear without the user's confirmation. The reply is in Spanish.

evals.prompt: Revisa el plan del issue #42: hay que añadir paginación a la exportación. El issue ya tiene una sección '## 🛠️ Plan de Implementación' con '> Estado: planificado' de una versión anterior.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes the legacy Spanish '## 🛠️ Plan de Implementación' section as the existing plan and treats the request as a revision, not a new plan. It updates that same section, keeps the Spanish markers (heading and 'Estado: planificado') instead of adding a second English section, adds the pagination requirement, scenario and tasks, shows the result and asks for confirmation before running gh issue edit --body-file. The reply is in Spanish.
